senses.gloss: दम- + घोष दम- + घोष, m. a proper name, MBh. 1, 7029.

दम् दम्, i. 4, दाम्य, Par.
 1. To be tamed.
 2. To tame, MBh. 7, 2379.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दान्त, Tamed, MBh. 3, 15704. m.
 1. A steer, a young bullock, Rājat. 5, 432.
 2. One who has subdued his passions, calm, Man. 4, 35.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. दम्य,
 1. To be tamed for labour, Man. 8, 146.
 2. m. A steer, a young bullock, MBh. 12, 6590.
 --Caus. दमय,
 1. To subdue, MBh. 1, 2995.
 2. To break, Rājat. 4, 265.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To subdue, MBh. 12, 6596.
 --Cf. δάμνημι, δαμνάω, δαμάω (= ved. दमायामि; Lat. domare), δμώς; Lat. damnare, damnum; Goth. ga-timan; O.H.G. zeman, zam; A.S. tam, tamian; Lat. densus; δασύς, etc., cf. दम्पति.

दम दम् + अ, m.
 1. Self-command, Man. 4, 246.
 2. A fine, Man. 9, 230.
 3. Punishment, chastisement, Man. 9, 284; Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 20.
 4. The name of a Ṛṣi, MBh. 13, 1762.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. दम्पति.
ऽदाम -दाम, a substitute for दामन् when being latter part of a comp. word, n. A string, MBh. 6, 2447. उद्-दाम, adj., f. मा, Unrestrained, Rām. 2, 23, 21.
दमक दम् + अक, adj. Taming, a tamer, Man. 3, 162.

दमन दम् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Subduing, [] Bhartṛ. 3, 47.
 II. n.
 1. Subduing, Bhartṛ. 2, 52.
 2. Chastising, Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 14.
 III. m. A proper name, Nal. 1, 6.
 --Comp.
दमनक दमन + क, m. A proper name, Pañc. 9, 19.
दमयन्ती दमयन्ती, fem. of the pres. ptcple. of the Causal of दम्, A proper name, Nal. 1, 9.
दमयितृ दमयितृ, i. e. दम्, Caus., + तृ, m. A chastiser, MBh. 13, 7041.

दमिन् दमिन्, i. e. दम + इन्, adj. One who has subdued his passions, MBh. 3, 5016.
 --Comp.

दम्पति दम्पति, probably दंस् (= δῶ and δες) -पति (= ποτης), m. The master of the house; dual ती, The master and the mistress; husband and wife, Man. 3, 116; a couple, Pañc. 225, 22.
 --Cf. δεσπότης, δόμος (= ved. दम), δέμω; Lat. domus; Goth. timrjan; A.S. timber, timbrian.
दम्भ् दम्भ्, see दभ्.

दम्भ दम्भ् + अ, m.
 1. Deceit, Pañc. i. d. 222.
 2. Feigning, Rājat. 6, 195.
 3. Arrogance, Mārk. P. 34, 46.
 --Comp.
दम्भक दम्भ् + अक, adj. Deluding, Man. 4, 195.
दम्भन दम्भ् + अन, n. Deceit, Man. 4, 198.
दम्भिन् दम्भिन्, i. e. दम्भ + इन्, m. A deceiver, Pañc. iv. d. 39.

दामन् 3. दा + मन्, n. A rope, MBh. 1, 6678.
 2. A string, Rām. 2, 78, 7. []
 3. A garland, Megh. 89.
 4. A large bandage to support parts, Suśr. 1, 65, 17.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. δέμα, κρήδεμνον.
दामनी दामन् + ई, f. A rope for tying cattle, Hariv. 3536.
ऽदामनीक -दामनी + क = दामनी at the end of a comp. adj., Hariv. 4354.

दामोदर दामोदर, i. e. दामन्-उदर, m.
 1. A name of Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 5, 2566.
 2. A proper name, Rājat. 1, 64.
दाम्पत्य दाम्पत्य, i. e. दम्पति + य, n. Matrimonial bliss, Bhāg. P. 2, 3, 7.

दाम्भिक दाम्भिक, i. e. दम्भ + इक, adj.
 1. Deceitful, Man. 12, 44.
 2. A cheat, Man. 3, 159.
 3. A hypocrite, Man. 4, 211.
